[{"step":1,"file":"fuzzer/FuzzPacket.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":20,"var":"Data","code":"memcpy(lexer.inbufptr = lexer.inbuffer, Data, Size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied verbatim into the lexer input buffer for packet recognition."},{"step":2,"file":"gpsd/packet.c","function":"packet_parse","line":2041,"var":"lexer->inbuffer","code":"case RTCM3_RECOGNIZED:","note":"The packet state machine classifies the copied bytes as an RTCM3 packet candidate and enters the RTCM3 handler."},{"step":3,"file":"gpsd/packet.c","function":"packet_parse","line":2355,"var":"idx","code":"for (idx = 0; idx < inbuflen; idx++) { if (0xd3 == lexer->inbuffer[idx]) { break; } }","note":"The handler searches for the RTCM3 preamble but assumes it exists, so idx can advance to inbuflen when the preamble is absent."},{"step":4,"file":"gpsd/packet.c","function":"packet_parse","line":2363,"var":"data_len","code":"data_len = (lexer->inbuffer[idx + 1] << 8) | lexer->inbuffer[idx + 2];","note":"Because idx may equal inbuflen, the code reads past the end of inbuffer while computing the RTCM3 length field."},{"step":5,"file":"gpsd/packet.c","function":"packet_parse","line":2376,"var":"gps_hexdump(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &lexer->inbuffer[idx], data_len + 6 + 3)","code":"gps_hexdump(outbuf, sizeof(outbuf), &lexer->inbuffer[idx], data_len + 6 + 3);","note":"The out-of-bounds pointer and oversized length are then passed to the hexdump/logging path, producing the stack-buffer-overflow read sink."}]
EOF
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && printf '
---submit---
' && bash ../submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpsd/fuzzer/FuzzPacket.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
